result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback limits for E&O (USD 1M) and cyber (USD 2M), and retains statutory workers’ compensation and certificates on request. However, CGL is stated only as USD 1M generally, not USD 1M per occurrence with a USD 2M aggregate, so the playbook position is not met. The cyber trigger also extends to mere access to any Company data or Confidential Information, which is broader than the specified trigger of processing Customer Data, and it does not expressly require privacy coverage. The drafting otherwise preserves the clause’s unrelated commercial intent.
